title: Arlo
description:
Dance with Demons, Skirt to Survive
Survival in Arlo isn't about overpowering adversaries; it's about swift movement and evasion. The arena brims with danger as enemies rush, creating fleeting gaps and opportunities. Constant movement is vital - evade assaults, dart through openings, and maneuver strategically to survive.

Speed and precision are your allies. Deftly skirt and collect experience, aiming and leveling up to enhance your capabilities. In this unforgiving arena, power means little without agility. Your fate rests on your moves. Survive, adapt, and outmaneuver the encroaching darkness. This is not just a battle; it's a dance for survival.Lacking damages ?Take some risks and get closer !Your damage multiplier increase based on proximity with enemiesFeatures:• 27 weapons with 11 unique attack.

• More than 70 equipment with different base stats.

• 6 passive attacks to support you.

• Your decisions determines the pace of your journey. Are you willing to take the risks for a quicker run?
Enter the arena, aim with precision, skirt with agility, and defy your demons. Survival demands not just strength but accuracy and finesse.
description_short: Skirt, attack, face thousands of enemies and level-up to survive. 27 weapons with 11 different main attacks and more than 70 equipment. Customize your starter character and dodge hundreds of enemies rushing to you while you level-up and boost your stats or pick passive attacks.
